claim: Every turn has ONE unified trace correlating the mind and the machine: a turn_id minted once at the top of the turn, with vera + argus + quality + cost + safety sections, recorded append-only, and a viewer that renders it. 'No turn_id = not observable.'
owner: anima/whole_mri.py (mint_turn_id/assemble/record/by_turn_id, UnifiedTrace), anima/host_window.py (host before/during/after window), anima/server.py (_turn mints turn_id + assembles+records the UnifiedTrace last, after the final gate), scripts/whole_mri.py (viewer render_full), scripts/certify_whole_mri.py

killer_test.name: every_turn_has_unified_trace_turnid_correlated_viewer_renders
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store. Drive a turn through anima.server._turn (deterministic reference-recall seam, no model needed). Assert: out['turn_id'] is a format-valid id; whole_mri.by_turn_id(name, turn_id) returns a trace whose vera/argus/quality/cost/safety sections are present and validate; assemble('') raises and record() without a turn_id raises (turn_id is mandatory); safety.final_gate_passed True and trace.vera.response.chars == len(shipped reply); the viewer render_full(by_turn_id) is a non-empty string emitting the named sections. (With Host Awareness OFF the trace is STILL recorded — argus.enabled False, queries empty.) Real .anima byte-unchanged.
killer_test.prompt: what did I upload about the blue copper ladder 92817?

known_gaps: Several vera sub-sections are 'N/A in live turn' BY DESIGN (situation/meaning/reality_learning are built at sleep / on demand, not per-turn) — the trace records them as explicit skips, not silent gaps. The cert should confirm the per-turn sections (capture/memory/lerf/generation/final_gate/response + cost + safety) are populated, and the on-demand ones are honestly marked rather than missing.
Argus cost/host-window deltas are only populated when host_awareness is ON and a certified Argus is reachable; OFF turns legitimately carry empty argus.queries (still a valid, recorded trace).
